verdict.rationale: Docs give some security-relevant details — the OAuth sign-in scope statement (name/email/photo only, no auto data access), the SKILL.md format distinguishing instruction-only vs script-bearing skills, and the curated marketplace/plugin-creator wiring — but there is no consolidated security-posture doc covering what skills can execute (sandboxing, permissions), a clear third-party trust model, or any telemetry/data-collection statement; indeed docs-5 shows a plugin reading/sending iMessage with no stated safeguards. missing for 10: explicit execution/sandbox model for skills, explicit third-party skill vetting/trust policy, and any telemetry or data-collection disclosure.
